fields.name: file download
fields.description: A method for downloading files directly from a server.

fields.name: API
fields.description: Application Programming Interface (API) allows software applications to communicate with each other.

fields.name: OGC WMS
fields.description: Web Map Service (WMS) is a standard protocol for serving georeferenced map images over the Internet.

fields.name: OGC WFS
fields.description: Web Feature Service (WFS) is a standard for serving geospatial features over the Internet.

fields.name: OGC WCS
fields.description: Web Coverage Service (WCS) is a standard for serving raster data over the Internet.

fields.name: OGC CSW
fields.description: Catalogue Service for the Web (CSW) is a standard for exposing a catalogue of geospatial records.

fields.name: OGC API
fields.description: OGC API standards define modular API building blocks to spatially enable Web APIs in a consistent way.

fields.name: OData
fields.description: Open Data Protocol (OData) is a standard protocol for building and consuming RESTful APIs.

fields.name: OAI-PMH
fields.description: Open Archives Initiative Protocol for Metadata Harvesting (OAI-PMH) is a protocol for harvesting metadata descriptions.

fields.name: OpenSearch
fields.description: OpenSearch is a collection of technologies that allow publishing of search results in a format suitable for syndication and aggregation.

fields.name: OPeNDAP
fields.description: Open-source Project for a Network Data Access Protocol (OPeNDAP) is a protocol for accessing scientific data.

fields.name: ArcGIS Feature Service
fields.description: ArcGIS Feature Service allows users to access and edit geographic features over the web.

fields.name: ArcGIS Map Service
fields.description: ArcGIS Map Service allows users to share maps, layers, and other geographic information over the web.
